h1: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Dispur

h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Dispur

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Dispur

c: As the seat of Assam's government, Dispur has secretariat buildings, government staff quarters and office campuses, and each of them can use an outdoor gym. FunPlay Systems supplies Fun Fitness outdoor gym equipment to departments, housing complexes, schools and public parks in Dispur and the rest of Guwahati. The machines are made at our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, about 2,080 km away, and come to Assam by road.

Government buyers usually need clear paperwork before approval. We send a layout drawing that shows each machine, its clear space and the overall area, along with the product list and our warranty terms. Once the drawing and quote are approved, we manufacture, dispatch and install through our own team or a dealer in the northeast. Installation is grouted or self-standing, depending on whether the site is soil, paving or an existing hard floor.

items.q: Can you provide a layout drawing for departmental approval?
items.a: Yes. We send a drawing with each machine, the clear area around it and the overall size of the gym, along with the product list. You approve it and the quote before we start manufacturing.

items.q: How many people can use a multi gym at once?
items.a: The 6 Station Multi Gym has six exercise points on one frame, so up to six people can train at the same time if each uses a separate station.

items.q: Do you install in Dispur and the rest of Guwahati?
items.a: Yes. The machines travel by road from Vasai, and our installation team or a dealer in the northeast installs them on a grouted or self-standing base.
